question: The area (in cm²) of an equilateral triangle whose altitude from vertex is 9 cm, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an **equilateral triangle**, the **Area** can be directly calculated from its **altitude (h)**.

Direct Formula: **Area** = h² / √3

⇒ Area = 9² / √3 = 81 / √3

⇒ Area = (81 × √3) / 3 = 27√3 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 27√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Altitude (h) = 9 cm

**Formula Used:** Altitude (h) = (√3 / 2) × a; Area = (√3 / 4) × a²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00846474090d7422a27184acddbc68e6418e17a9999b9f6ddea7499f876dc614.png] 

⇒ 9 = (√3 / 2) × a

⇒ a = 18 / √3

⇒ a = 6√3 cm

⇒ Area = (√3 / 4) × (6√3)²

⇒ Area = (√3 / 4) × (36 × 3)

⇒ Area = (√3 / 4) × 108

⇒ Area = 27√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 27√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equilateral Triangle Properties

All sides are equal (a) and all internal angles are 60°. Perimeter = 3a.

Inradius and Circumradius

Inradius (r) = a / (2√3) and Circumradius (R) = a / √3. Ratio R : r = 2 : 1.

Area-Altitude Relation

Area is proportional to the square of the altitude: Area = h² / √3.</p
